Our Vision & Products

EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

We are looking for a Trust & Safety Product Manager to own the product and technical delivery of our compliance and safety initiatives across our platforms.

You will turn safety requirements into effective product features, moderation capabilities, third-party integrations, and measurable improvements. Working closely with Compliance, Engineering, AI/ML, Product, and Customer Support, you will help us identify risks earlier, build safeguards into new features, and continuously improve how our safety systems perform.

This is a newly created role within our Product team, working directly with our CTO, Michael Monin and our Legal & Safety Lead, Maxwelle Sokol. You will have significant ownership from the outset and the opportunity to shape how the safety product function develops as the company continues to grow.

Our platform serves adults and permits lawful adult content. We are looking for someone who can navigate sensitive, context-dependent issues thoughtfully, protecting users and enforcing clear boundaries without unnecessarily restricting legitimate expression.

Here’s what you can expect:

Key Responsibilities

  • Safety & legal product strategy and delivery. Translate safety policies, legal requirements (e.g., in online safety and AI-specific laws such as the EU AI Act), incident findings, and user feedback into clear product requirements, acceptance criteria, and engineering work. Drive initiatives from problem definition through implementation, testing, launch, and ongoing improvement.

  • Internally developed moderation technologies. Own the product side of improvements to our in-house moderation systems, including our proprietary LLM technology EverGuard. Partner with Engineering and AI/ML teams on, e.g., detection capabilities, moderation rules and thresholds, and appropriate interventions across user inputs and AI-generated outputs.

  • Third-party safety partnerships and integrations. Lead the technical and product lifecycle of third-party safety partnerships, from identifying needs and evaluating providers to implementation, testing, rollout, and ongoing performance management.

  • Safety dashboards, monitoring, and quality assurance. Establish dashboards and a recurring QA that help us proactively identify emerging issues, prevent harmful content, and ensure that our T&S measures are working as intended.

  • Red teaming and adversarial testing. Own our testing for how moderation systems and product safeguards respond to deliberate misuse and difficult edge cases. Track findings through remediation, retesting, and closure—not just delivery of a report.

  • Trust and safety reviews for new features. Establish and run a dedicated T&S review for new features, with proportionate reviews for material changes to existing features, models, and integrations. Engage early in product design to identify foreseeable misuse, affected users, and appropriate safeguards.

  • Incident follow-through and continuous improvement. Coordinate the product and engineering response to significant safety issues, working with colleagues responsible for incident management, policy, and user support.

Learn more about our Trust & Safety infrastructure in our Trust & Safety Hub.

Your Qualifications

  • Data-driven product decisions that align with legal/ethical standards: You can name the metrics you want to influence, explain why it matters, and say whether your work actually moved them. You’ve run A/B tests, product experiments, data deep-dives, or lightweight user research and used the findings to shape what was built next. You can assess risks associated with user-generated content, transactions, and interactions, and translate these into policies that align with legal and ethical standards, trackers/dashboards, and strategic planning;

  • Content moderation and AI guardrails: You understand how product realities and safety requirements interact on a tech platform; you explore strategies for efficient and scalable content moderation, including automation, machine learning, human review and user reporting.

  • Legal/safety work experience: You have worked closely with trust and safety and compliance requirements and understand how to translate and implement these for a consumer-facing product;

  • Collaborative mindset and communication: You work cross-functionally with engineering, legal, operations, and customer support teams — these are your partners and support system, not your adversaries or a box to be checked. You ask the right questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and are fully fluent and comfortable in English;

  • AI fluency: You are completely comfortable working with and leveraging AI tools. You actively seek out and experiment with new tools and techniques without waiting for a project or manager to require them;

  • You are point person for third-party partnerships: You proactively test and can autonomously handle discussions with third-party tools and integrations that affect our compliance and safety posture;

  • You take ownership and move without waiting for certainty: Comfortable with ambiguity, you create clarity by investigating, building, testing, and learning rather than waiting for a complete brief. You balance execution against planning, address blockers early, and take responsibility for the outcome rather than waiting to be told what to do, caring more about reaching the right result than following a fixed process;

  • You are comfortable with the product category: you are fully comfortable building products based on uncensored models and content;

Bonus points

  • You have previous legal/compliance education

  • Professional experience or interest in AI

  • Experience with consumer-facing features, particularly in the entertainment or gaming industry

Soft Skills

Strong communication & collaborative skills (perfectly fluent in English)

Goal-oriented, ownership and commitment

⚡️ Doer mindset - we are moving fast and need people who can balance execution, planning, and strategy

Humble - willing to learn, open to feedback

#NSFW - Comfortable reviewing and discussing uncensored AI-generated content and NSFW material

We believe strongly that information can be learned, but effort and motivation cannot. If this role appeals to you but you don’t have hands-on experience in all the fields listed in this job description, apply anyway and tell us why you’d be a good fit!

Why EverAI?

Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
‍‍‍ Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍ Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, SOC Experience
jobs.jd_full:
What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 16M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

Reports To: Director of Product Management, Platform

Location: Remote US

Compensation: $190,000 to $220,000 base plus bonus and equity

About The Role:

We are building a product management organization to own and drive our product strategy, and we are looking for an experienced product manager to own a new team focused entirely on Security tooling for the Huntress SOC.

Our SOC is the cornerstone of the Huntress Security Platform, serving SMB and mid-market clients through MSP/MSSP and Reseller channels. It delivers premium, human+AI services at a scale most companies can't match — Rapid Response, Tactical Response, and Hypercare together accounted for roughly 150 engagements in a single recent month. Much of that delivery still runs on an internal SOC platform that does not match analysts' current needs - this includes spreadsheets, Slack threads, and per-engagement documents. Our analysts work on a surface that has never had a first-class experience.

You will own the internal security experience: the surface our SOC works in every day, the tooling that makes our response services repeatable, and the shared investigation and evidence model the rest of the SOC platform is built on. This is the delivery engine behind the margin thesis — the work that enables us to grow the business without growing SOC headcount linearly. It is also the foundation layer, so the interfaces you publish are consumed by our agentic automation team and our partner-facing product team.

Your users are professional security analysts, and they are down the hall. You will get direct, immediate, unfiltered feedback on everything you ship from people who do this work for a living.

You will work closely with SOC leadership, engineering leaders, support, and other Product Managers. To be successful in this position, you need real fluency in how a SOC actually operates — how analysts triage, investigate, escalate, and report — and the judgment to tell the difference between a workflow that needs product support versus not. You will be building internal-facing systems where the return is measured in analyst throughput and time-to-close rather than ARR, and you will need to make that case clearly to executive stakeholders.

What You’ll Do:

  • Work with the Director of Product, the Head of SOC, and other relevant stakeholders to set the SOC tooling vision and strategy, and clearly articulate the business value so that everyone understands where we are headed
  • Own the roadmap for analyst UX, Rapid Response and Tactical Response tooling, product support and operations, and SOC platform
  • Serve as the primary steward of the shared investigation and evidence model — canvas, queues, triage package — and publish the interface adjacent product teams build on
  • Partner with SOC leadership, analysts, and Tactical Response to turn manual, out-of-product processes into standardized, automation-first internal workflows
  • Take ownership of the Portal Enhancement Kit and drive analyst-built improvements into the native product so the best of internal tooling becomes the best of product
  • Demonstrate an ability to decipher and articulate potentially ambiguous operator needs and mold them into successful, innovative solutions

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Claude Corps (Fellow Experience)
jobs.jd_full:
CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We’ve trained over 40,000 students from 1,000+ universities, and our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. We’ve spent nearly a decade training the next generation of technical talent, and we just launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic, building one of the most ambitious AI workforce programs in the world.

We’re now expanding into new markets and scaling our team so we can move at the speed AI is transforming the workforce. People joining CodePath now will have the opportunity to help architect the next frontier of our work.

We believe technical skill is the fastest way to turn raw talent into real opportunity. We train the engineers the AI era runs on, building toward millions of learners, hundreds of millions in revenue, and billions in economic impact. If you want to own something and be part of a 0-to-1 journey at an organization moving at the speed of AI, this is the place to build it.

Location: Remote (U.S.), with regular travel for in-person events Role type: Full-time Reports to: Kelly Mosher, Program Lead, Claude Corps Compensation: $130,000 to $155,000

About Claude Corps

In June 2026, Anthropic and CodePath launched Claude Corps, a $150M national fellowship. It places 1,000 paid, AI-skilled fellows in 12-month roles at mission-driven organizations across the country. Anthropic funds the program and sets strategy. CodePath employs the fellows and leads their training and programming.

The program is growing fast. Cohort 1 started in October 2026 with 100 fellows. Cohort 2 starts in March 2027 with 300. Cohort 3 starts in late summer 2027 with 600. Many fellows relocate to a new city for the year, so their experience, from offer letter to last day, decides whether the program works.

About the role

You’ll be the Program Lead’s right hand: a senior program manager who can take a whole area of Claude Corps, set the plan, and run it without being managed day to day. That frees Kelly to focus on program operations and strategy across the fellowship.

Your first area is the fellow experience, which today has no single end-to-end owner. You’ll own how we communicate with, connect, and gather fellows, from offer through their last day. As the program scales, your scope will shift to wherever the biggest gap is. That could mean host organization experience or another part of the program, and future hires (for example, a community manager) may report to you.

This is a generalist role by design. We’re hiring for strong program management judgment, not a single specialty.

What success looks like

First 30 days: learn it and take the wheel

  • Get to know Cohort 1 (100 fellows live now), the mentor team, and our Anthropic partners
  • Map the fellow journey from offer to day one, and name the three biggest gaps
  • Take over day-to-day fellow communications (program inbox, fellow Slack, regular updates) from your manager
  • Lock the Cohort 2 onboarding plan for 300 fellows: timeline, host matching updates, and relocation guidance

Days 31 to 60: deliver Cohort 2 Basecamp

  • Run the week-long Cohort 2 Basecamp kickoff (starting Feb 22) with our event agency and curriculum team. You’ll own the run of show, attendee experience, and on-site problem solving
  • Get every Cohort 2 fellow from signed offer to day one with clear, consistent communication

Days 61 to 90: build for scale

  • Launch a fellow support model that a small team can run for 1,000 fellows: self-serve resources, AI-assisted answers, and clear escalation to mentors, HR, and program leads
  • Stand up community rituals and peer structures that don’t depend on you to run
  • Report engagement, satisfaction, and retention to CodePath and Anthropic leadership

6 to 12 months

  • Cohort 3 (600 fellows) onboards on playbooks you wrote, with fewer people and fewer hours than Cohort 2
  • You’ve documented what works so another team could pick it up and run it
  • You’ve taken on a second program area where we need it most

What you’ll do

  • Own the plan. Set direction for your program area, make clear trade-offs, and tie the work to outcomes like fellow retention and engagement
  • Run the details. Keep many workstreams moving at once and close loops without reminders
  • Communicate well. Set honest expectations with fellows, keep the Claude Corps voice consistent, and keep host organizations informed in coordination with Anthropic’s host team
  • Build systems, not heroics. Use AI, including Claude, every day, and choose tools that let a small team serve thousands of people
  • Partner widely. Work closely with the mentor team, curriculum, HR, outside vendors, and Anthropic partners

What we’re looking for

Required

  • 7+ years in program management, including owning a cohort-based program, fellowship, or member community end to end
  • You’ve set direction for a program area yourself, not only carried out someone else’s plan
  • You can show how you run a heavy, changing workload: your system, what slipped once, and what you changed afterward
  • You’ve moved work from manual to systematic, and you use AI tools hands-on in your daily work
  • You write clearly and warmly and adjust your tone for fellows, executives, and partners
  • You can travel to multi-day events several times a year, including February and late summer 2027

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in two or more of: participant communications, community building, or large in-person events with an outside agency
  • Fellowships, service programs like AmeriCorps, or early-career talent programs
  • Supporting participants through a relocation or major life transition
  • Experience at a nonprofit, in education, or at a fast-growing startup

Full-Time Employee Benefits

This is a remote position—work from anywhere in the US! CodePath prioritizes employee well-being with a competitive benefits package to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance.

  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance (90% employer-covered for employees and dependents), employer-funded healthcare reimbursement, FSAs, and Employee Assistance Program
  • Financial Security: 401(k), employer-paid life & disability insurance, and identity theft protection
  • Work-Life Balance: Generous PTO, paid holidays, 10 weeks of fully paid parental leave, and an annual year-end company closure (Dec 24 – Jan 2)
  • Professional Growth: $1,000 annual professional development stipend and home office setup support
  • ​​Student Loan Forgiveness: CodePath is a qualifying employer for Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), helping employees manage student loan debt
  • Additional Perks: Pet wellness plans, legal services, home/auto insurance discounts, and exclusive marketplace savings

Pay range

$130,000—$155,000 USD
